task.name: observatory-chat
task.instruction: Answer the latest user message. Prior messages are conversation context.

playground.title: Successful turn
playground.description: Retain lifecycle, usage, outcome and a cut.
playground.text: Explain what a Shepherd trace records in two sentences.

playground.title: Provider failure
playground.description: Observe a failed outcome without fabricated usage.
playground.text: Exercise the offline provider failure case.

playground.title: Cancellation
playground.description: Start a slow turn, then press Stop.
playground.text: Exercise a slow offline turn so I can stop it.

playground.title: Follow-up context
playground.description: Inspect the retained transcript in the next creation record.
playground.text: Summarize my preceding question and your reply.

playground.title: Literal text
playground.description: Verify HTML-like input renders as plain text.

display.overviewText: Shepherd validates a task, retains its invocation boundary, accounts supplied usage, and commits an outcome with an immutable cut. Select a node to see the evidence behind that step.

statusDescriptions.finished: Shepherd validated the reply, retained supplied usage and the successful outcome, then published an immutable execution cut.
statusDescriptions.failed: The invocation failed. Shepherd retained the failure and terminal cut; unavailable usage is not fabricated.
statusDescriptions.cancelled: The owned invocation stopped and cleanup completed. Shepherd retained a cancelled outcome and terminal cut.
statusDescriptions.exhausted: A configured execution budget ended the turn. Shepherd retained the exact exhausted outcome and available evidence.
statusDescriptions.created: Task input, provider identity and budget are retained. No invocation start has been retained yet.
statusDescriptions.started: The invocation boundary is retained. The adapter is answering; observed RPC events are separate evidence.
statusDescriptions.committed: The terminal execution evidence and its immutable cut are retained.
statusDescriptions.terminal_pending_cut: Terminal evidence exists but the cut is incomplete. Inspect it; the UI never retries or repairs automatically.

recordDescriptions.title: Task validation
recordDescriptions.description: Retains the exact task artifact lock, validated input, provider identity and budget before invocation.

recordDescriptions.title: Invocation boundary
recordDescriptions.description: Records that the fenced provider boundary was reached. A missing terminal result remains uncertain after interruption.

recordDescriptions.title: Usage accounting
recordDescriptions.description: Retains usage supplied by the adapter. Offline usage is synthetic fixture data; absent live usage is never estimated.

recordDescriptions.title: Run outcome
recordDescriptions.description: Binds finished, failed, exhausted or cancelled status to the exact task artifact. Its parents cite the evidence used.

recordDescriptions.title: Successful lifecycle
recordDescriptions.description: Retains the successful lifecycle projection and the final run-control snapshot; it cites the successful outcome.

recordDescriptions.title: Non-success lifecycle
recordDescriptions.description: Retains the failure lifecycle projection. Inspect the outcome to distinguish failed, cancelled and exhausted.

recordDescriptions.title: Immutable execution cut
recordDescriptions.description: Publishes the exact retained owner prefix through the terminal lifecycle record. Later appends cannot extend this address.

recordDescriptions.title: RPC observation
recordDescriptions.description: Retains the source event type and sequence, citing the invocation record. This is an observation, not governed tool execution.
